purpose: Verify the underlying physical condition while removing unsupported speculative or over-specific details instead of rejecting an otherwise real defect.
privacy_and_methodology: Never send filename, stem, path, annotation text, expected label, or ground-truth status to the model.
The verifier may receive only the detector-generated candidate fields and visual evidence.
Detector confidence is metadata, not proof.

reject: Reject when the underlying physical condition itself is not visibly supported.
Reject when only an unrelated nearby condition is visible.
Reject when normalization would require changing the candidate into a different physical defect.
normalize_and_accept: Accept when the underlying physical condition is visibly supported but one or more descriptive details are unsupported.
Return a conservative normalized description containing only visible evidence.
Normalization may make the description less specific but must preserve the same physical condition and location.
accept_unchanged: Accept when the candidate's core physical condition and material descriptive details are visibly supported.

critical_guardrail: A nearby different defect must never be used to validate or rewrite an unsupported candidate.

examples.input: Exposed mounting hole with visible screw head on cabinet door
examples.visible_evidence: Exposed mounting hole is visible; screw head is not confirmed.
examples.normalized_description: Exposed mounting hole on cabinet door

examples.input: Visible water droplet falling from bathtub rim
examples.visible_evidence: No falling droplet is visible; a separate bathtub crack is visible nearby.
examples.reason: The crack is a different physical condition and cannot rescue the droplet candidate.

examples.input: Dark staining visible on wood-grain flooring
examples.visible_evidence: Only natural wood grain and knots are visible.
examples.reason: The underlying stain condition is unsupported.

success_criteria: Accept or conservatively normalize defect_13 1.0s vanity mounting observation.
Do not require acceptance of the weaker defect_13 3.0s duplicate observation if its core physical condition is not sufficiently supported.
